title: DeepFEAv2: Deep Learning for Transient Finite Element Analysis Beyond Structured Meshes
abstract: arXiv:2609.26426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Finite Element Analysis (FEA) is widely used for transient mechanical simulations, but its high computational cost limits real-time and high-resolution applications. Deep learning surrogate models can reduce this cost; however, many existing approaches are restricted to steady-state prediction or cannot jointly predict Node- and Element-based Outputs (NEO) over time. The state-of-the-art DeepFEA framework has addressed these issues but remains limited to structured finite element (FE) meshes. translated_abstract: 有限元分析（FEA）被广泛用于瞬态力学仿真，但其高昂的计算成本限制了实时和高分辨率应用。深度学习代理模型可以降低这一成本；然而，许多现有方法仅限于稳态预测，或者无法随时间联合预测基于节点和基于单元的输出（NEO）。最先进的DeepFEA框架已经解决了这些问题，但仍然局限于结构化有限元（FE）网格。为了克服这一限制，本研究提出了DeepFEAv2，这是一个深度学习代理框架，能够在不同的有限元网格拓扑和单元类型上实现瞬态有限元分析仿真的预测。DeepFEAv2的主要贡献包括：（a）一个利用有限元连接矩阵按单元组织输入特征、并根据网格拓扑将其排列为输入序列的模块；（b）一种新颖的神经网络架构，其设计旨在
tldr: DeepFEAv2是一个突破结构化网格限制的深度学习代理框架，能够跨不同有限元网格拓扑和单元类型进行瞬态有限元分析的节点与单元输出联合预测。
en_tdlr: DeepFEAv2 is a deep learning surrogate framework that goes beyond structured meshes, enabling joint prediction of node- and element-based outputs in transient FEA simulations across different FE mesh topologies and element types.
